# Practical AI Laboratories

This section contains hands-on experiments using
Python, automotive datasets, machine-learning frameworks
and autonomous-driving simulation environments.

All laboratories include theoretical explanations,
executable Python examples, visualizations,
experiments and safety-related assignments.
